Adjusted EBITDA turned negative at EUR (0.449) million compared to a positive EUR 5.2 million previously, while earnings per share fell to EUR (0.97) from EUR 0.43.

verified_key_information_units.information: Key period-over-period changes included an 8% decline in served travelers (239 thousand in 2024 vs 259 thousand in 2023) and a swing from positive to negative EBITDA (€5.2m to -€6.1m). The result was primarily driven by increased competitive pressures in the Baltic travel market, particularly in Turkey and Greek islands, coupled with a one-off EUR 5.7 million goodwill impairment related to the Estonian cash-generating unit.

The adverse financial performance was primarily caused by an intensified competitive environment and a regional oversupply of travel packages in the Baltic States, which triggered aggressive price wars, particularly for Turkish and Greek destinations.

verified_key_information_units.information: In early 2025, strategic investor Neset Kockar acquired 23.2% of Novaturas' shares (completed on 30 April 2025), with a planned further acquisition to reach 33.19% by autumn 2025.
